title: Riemannian Optimization for Multi-Player Quantum Games on Product Unitary Manifolds
abstract: arXiv:2609.07397v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Quantum game theory is an extension of classical game theory that uses quantum principles in game theory. The Eisert-Wilkens-Lewenstein (EWL) quantum game is an early example of the two-player classical Prisoner's Dilemma transformed into a quantum Prisoner's Dilemma. In the EWL game, the players choose pure quantum strategies represented by unitary matrices. This extension can resolve the classical dilemma by enabling cooperative equilibrium with higher payoff. In this paper, we first discuss the Extended EWL (EEWL) for multiplayer quantum games with mixed strategies. In EEWL, each player controls a set of unitary operators as quantum actions and uses a classical mixed strategy over these actions. The payoffs are defined as expectation values of Hermitian reward operators acting on a shared quantum state, which is generated and measured according to the EEWL protocol. translated_title: 乘积酉流形上多人量子博弈的黎曼优化
translated_abstract: 量子博弈论是经典博弈论的扩展，它将量子原理应用于博弈论之中。Eisert-Wilkens-Lewenstein（EWL）量子博弈是将双人经典囚徒困境转化为量子囚徒困境的早期典型例子。在EWL博弈中，参与者选择由酉矩阵表示的纯量子策略。这种扩展可以通过实现具有更高收益的合作均衡来解决经典困境。在本文中，我们首先讨论了面向具有混合策略的多人量子博弈的扩展EWL（EEWL）框架。在EEWL中，每个参与者控制一组酉算子作为量子动作，并对这些动作使用经典混合策略。收益被定义为作用于共享量子态的厄米特奖励算子的期望值，该量子态根据EEWL协议生成并测量。随后，我们提出了酉策略矩阵指数算法
tldr: 本文提出了面向混合策略多人量子博弈的扩展EWL（EEWL）框架，并引入酉策略矩阵指数算法，通过在乘积酉流形上进行黎曼优化来求解多人量子博弈的均衡问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Extended EWL (EEWL) framework for multiplayer quantum games with mixed strategies and introduces the Unitary Strategy Matrix Exponential Algorithm, which solves multiplayer quantum games via Riemannian optimization on product unitary manifolds.
